title: Jeff Bezos might finally get his hands on a sports team | TechCrunch
summary: Bezos, alongside others including Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin, is looking to buy at least a 30% stake in the English soccer team Liverpool at a £1.35 billion valuation (around $1.8 billion), The Guardian reports .
